objective: Completar la auditoria fisica anti-duplicacion de Production Quality / Foto Finish mediante consultas SQL Server estrictamente READ_ONLY y focalizadas. Inspeccionar candidatos exactos y semanticos para ProductionItem, ProductionStation, QualityStandard/Version, Measurement, ProductionEvidence, QualityDecision, Rework, QualityOverride, Device y DeviceCalibration. Auditar las estructuras adicionales de Tablajeria descubiertas en Gate5A-R1 y determinar el bounded context de Sync_Control_Evidencias y otras capacidades potencialmente colisionantes. No crear, alterar ni eliminar objetos. No auto-advance a Gate5B.

queries.name: pq_exact_object_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(o.name, '_', ''), '-', '')) IN (
    'productionitem',
    'productionstation',
    'qualitystandard',
    'qualitystandardversion',
    'measurement',
    'measurements',
    'productionevidence',
    'qualitydecision',
    'rework',
    'qualityoverride',
    'device',
    'devices',
    'devicecalibration'
)
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: pq_semantic_object_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%calidad%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%station%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%estacion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%dispositivo%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rework%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%retrabajo%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%override%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%parrilla%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%grill%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%foto%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%finish%'
ORDER BY o.type_desc, schema_name, object_name

queries.name: pq_semantic_column_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    t.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = o.object_id
JOIN sys.types t
  ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE
       LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%calidad%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%station%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%estacion%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%dispositivo%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%rework%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%retrabajo%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%override%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%temperatura%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%temperature%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%peso%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%weight%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%foto%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%camera%'
    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%camara%'
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, c.column_id

queries.name: targeted_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(po.schema_id) AS parent_schema,
    po.name AS parent_object,
    fk.name AS foreign_key_name,
    COL_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id, fkc.parent_column_id) AS parent_column,
    SCHEMA_NAME(ro.schema_id) AS referenced_schema,
    ro.name AS referenced_object,
    COL_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id, fkc.referenced_column_id) AS referenced_column
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
  ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.objects po
  ON po.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.objects ro
  ON ro.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
WHERE
       LOWER(po.name) LIKE '%tablaje%'
    OR LOWER(ro.name) LIKE '%tablaje%'
    OR LOWER(po.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(ro.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(po.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(ro.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(po.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(ro.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(po.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(ro.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_object, foreign_key_name

queries.name: targeted_indexes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.is_unique,
    i.is_primary_key,
    i.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.indexes i
  ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE i.name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
  )
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, index_name

queries.name: targeted_check_constraints
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    cc.name AS constraint_name,
    cc.definition
FROM sys.check_constraints cc
JOIN sys.objects o
  ON o.object_id = cc.parent_object_id
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, constraint_name
